product.olivetti-philos-11.summary: The entry model in the professional Philos line.
product.olivetti-philos-11.history: Olivetti introduced the Philos family in 1993 with a design by Michele De Lucchi. Its December BYTE advertisement positioned the 11 as the affordable model and the 44 at the upper end.
product.olivetti-philos-11.architecture: The family was designed for mobile work. Olivetti’s advertising documents the offer with Windows 3.1 and Lotus Organizer.
product.olivetti-philos-11.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-11.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
